services.name: Driving & Walking Tours
services.desc: Experience the vibrant flavors, and culture of Ellicott City’s Route 40 Koreatown on a guided driving tour through one of Maryland’s most exciting international dining destinations. Cruise along the bustling corridor while discovering Korean restaurants, cafés, bakeries, and other local favorites that showcase the area’s rich Korean-American community. Along the way, learn about the history and growth of Koreatown along Route 40, hear stories about the businesses and neighborhoods that helped shape the area, and get recommendations for places to eat and explore.
